# Button

## Summary
The primary action control, which also renders as a link or a LinkTo without changing appearance.

## Shape
Emphasis is `@kind` — `default`, `primary`, `secondary`, `muted`, `destructive`, `text-only`,
`primary-dark`, `link`, `link-primary`, `link-muted` (with `danger` and the `secondary-light`/
`-dark` pair kept as deprecated aliases). `@size` runs `auto`, `extra-small`, `small`, `base`
upward. Passing `@href` renders an anchor and `@route`/`@models`/`@query` render a LinkTo, all
with identical styling, so navigation and mutation share one affordance. `@loading` keeps the
label while blocking input; `@disabled` removes the affordance. `@pill` and `@rectangular`
adjust the shape.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/button/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { Button } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
